parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The time when the policy expires.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

parameters.name: Objects
parameters.description: The IDs of the websites that you want to associate with the policy. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: SiteIds
parameters.description: Site IDs to associate. Separate multiple site IDs with English commas (",").

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The time when the policy takes effect.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

parameters.name: Template
parameters.description:
The name of the policy template. Valid value:

*   **promotion**: major events.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa create-custom-scene-policy --name test --template promotion --start-time 2021-11-07T17:00:00Z --end-time 2021-11-07T18:00:00Z --objects 70966210980000,70966210990000 --site-ids 70966210980000,70966210990000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa CreateCustomScenePolicy --region cn-hangzhou --SiteIds '70966210980000,70966210990000' --EndTime '2021-11-07T18:00:00Z' --StartTime '2021-11-07T17:00:00Z' --Objects '70966210980000,70966210990000' --Name test --Template promotion
